meta.name: ulw-research
meta.description: Maximum-saturation research orchestration: ALWAYS proposes the final materials first (PDF+DOCX default), then parallel explore+librarian swarms across codebase, web, official docs, and OSS repos — max-roster teammode when the harness has it — with live journaling, a recursive EXPAND loop driven by leads workers return in message text, empirical verification by running code, and a cited synthesis with charts/Mermaid/assets behind a mandatory visual-QA gate. ACTIVATES ONLY on an explicit user demand for research — the word 'ulw-research' in any prefix form, any 'ulw' research wording including combined invocations like 'mass ulw research', 'ultradebate' or 'hyperdebate' research requests, or an explicit request for research / deep research / an ultra-precise investigation, in any language. Never self-activates for ordinary questions, debugging, or implementation context-gathering. While active it overrides exploration-bounding defaults: exhaustive coverage is the goal.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动展开多路调研并生成带引用综合报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你需要穷尽式多源调研并产出严谨报告
copy.tagline_en: Automate exhaustive multi-source research and produce cited reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need multi-source deep research with a polished report

howto.what: 装上后，你要求做研究时，Claude 会先提出最终报告方案（默认产出 PDF 和 DOCX），再派多个小助手并行搜索代码库、网页、官方文档等，顺着线索反复深挖，用运行代码验证争议说法，最后交付一份带引用、图表、经视觉检查的研究报告。
howto.when: 当你说出“ulw-research”、“ulw 研究”、“ultradebate”等词，或以任何语言明确要求做研究、深度研究、超精确调查时才触发。普通提问、调试、收集背景不会触发。

say.text: 用 ulw-research 彻底调研这个开源库，给我 PDF+DOCX 报告。
say.note: 技能启动，先确认最终材料格式再派人并行搜索。

say.text: ulw-research：对比三种数据库的故障恢复方案，用代码验证争议点。
say.note: 有争议的结论会被运行代码实测后附证明。

say.text: 用 ulw-research 深度研究“数据网格”，线索追完，带引用和图表。
say.note: 会持续追线索直到收敛，附引用和图表。

howto.what_en: Claude proposes the final format (PDF+DOCX), spawns parallel explorer+librarian swarms over code/web/docs/OSS, exhausts leads, proves contested claims with code, and delivers a cited synthesis with charts/Mermaid after visual QA
howto.when_en: Only on explicit research: 'ulw-research', 'ulw' wording, 'ultradebate'/'hyperdebate', or a deep-research/ultra-precise investigation request. Never for ordinary questions or debugging.

say_en.text: Do a deep dive on this repo with ulw-research. Deliver PDF+DOCX.
say_en.note: Skill activates, confirms format, spawns parallel search.

say_en.text: ulw-research: compare DB failover options; run code to verify disputed claims.
say_en.note: Contested findings are tested by actually executing code.

say_en.text: ulw-research: deep-dive ‘data mesh’; exhaust leads; cite everything.
say_en.note: It loops on leads until convergence, with citations.
